analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow is caused by parse_data_sgroup() unconditionally incrementing the iterator (`++first`) after calls to read_text_to(..., ":") for each optional colon-delimited field (name/data/oper/unit/tag, and coords handling). If read_text_to() stops because `first==last` (no delimiter present), parse_data_sgroup still does `++first`, pushing the iterator past end. A later read_text_to() then dereferences this invalid iterator in its loop (`delims.find_first_of(*first)`), producing the OOB read at line 143.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: From MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseMolBlockProperties -> ParseMarvinSmartsLine -> SmartsToMol -> parseCXExtensions, attacker-controlled Marvin SMARTS/CXSMILES extension containing an SgD block with missing/truncated ':'-separated fields (or truncated before expected delimiters) reaches parse_data_sgroup(). Because delimiter presence is not validated before each `++first`, end iterator is advanced out-of-range; subsequent parsing triggers 1-byte heap OOB read in read_text_to().
